metadata.description: Research Dynamics Manifold (RDM) maps each article into a 3D space [0,1]^3 along Emergence (E), Impact (I), and Structural Connectivity (S) axes, then classifies it into one of 8 interpretive archetypes based on corpus-relative medians.

E_emergence.description: Temporal novelty — how cutting-edge is the article relative to the corpus?

price_index.description: Percentage of references published within the last 5 years of the article
price_index.interpretation: Higher = article cites recent work, suggesting frontier research

burst_level.description: Maximum Kleinberg burst strength among the article's keywords at publication year
burst_level.interpretation: Higher = article uses keywords experiencing a sudden popularity surge

keyword_novelty.description: Fraction of keywords whose first corpus appearance is within +/-2 years
keyword_novelty.interpretation: Higher = article introduces or adopts newly emerging terminology

I_impact.description: Multi-channel diffusion — how widely has the article been disseminated?
I_impact.formula: I = power_mean(MNCS, FWCI, citation_velocity, social_attention, alpha=0.5)
I_impact.aggregation: Sub-linear power mean (alpha=0.5) penalizes single-channel dominance; an article with moderate impact across multiple channels scores higher than one with extreme impact in only one channel.

mncs.description: Mean Normalized Citation Score — field-adjusted citation count
mncs.interpretation: Higher = more citations than field average

fwci.description: Field-Weighted Citation Impact — OpenAlex citation percentile by year
fwci.interpretation: Higher = article is in the top percentile of its field-year cohort

citation_velocity.interpretation: Higher = faster accumulation of citations over time

social_attention.interpretation: Higher = broader social/media attention beyond academic citations

S_connectivity.description: Structural position in the knowledge network — how central and bridging is the article?

betweenness.description: Betweenness centrality in the bibliographic coupling network
betweenness.interpretation: Higher = article sits on many shortest paths between other articles (information broker)

interdisciplinarity.description: Fraction of network neighbors belonging to different communities
interdisciplinarity.interpretation: Higher = article bridges multiple research communities

collaboration_breadth.description: Number of distinct author countries, normalized by corpus max

sigma.interpretation: Higher = structurally central article using trending keywords (bridge + burst synergy)

normalization.description: Each raw sub-indicator is transformed to its corpus percentile in [0,1]. This ensures scale invariance and comparability across corpora of different sizes.

rdm_score.interpretation: Euclidean distance to origin in the unit cube, normalized by the cube diagonal. Articles at (1,1,1) achieve RDM=1.

classification.method: Octant classification using corpus medians as decision thresholds
classification.description: Each axis is split at its median, creating 2^3 = 8 octants. Each octant corresponds to an interpretive archetype. This is empirically adaptive — thresholds adjust to each corpus.

Paradigm Shifters.description: High emergence, high impact, well connected — the most dynamic articles

Viral Novelties.description: Novel and high-impact but structurally isolated — breakout papers

Emerging Bridges.description: Novel and well connected, future potential but not yet high impact

Isolated Seeds.description: Early or niche innovations — isolated seeds of future research

Established Pillars.description: Intellectual backbone — foundational works well integrated in the network

Canonical Isolates.description: Highly cited classics not centrally positioned in the knowledge network

Silent Connectors.description: Underestimated methodological bridges — low novelty and impact but structurally important

Peripheral Works.description: Routine contributions — low across all three dimensions

how_to_read_a_record.I: Impact score [0,1] — higher = broader multi-channel diffusion
how_to_read_a_record.S: Structural Connectivity score [0,1] — higher = more central in knowledge network
how_to_read_a_record.RDM: Overall RDM score [0,1] — composite distance from origin
how_to_read_a_record.archetype: Classification into one of 8 interpretive archetypes based on corpus medians
how_to_read_a_record.dominant_axis: Which axis (E/I/S) has the highest value for this article
how_to_read_a_record.*_components: Raw and rank-normalized values for each sub-indicator, enabling drill-down interpretation

interpretation_guide.cross_phase_value: RDM data enriches Phase 8 (Knowledge Map) by providing: (1) archetype distribution as a macro-level finding, (2) Paradigm Shifters as frontier research candidates, (3) Silent Connectors as undervalued bridges worth highlighting, (4) Isolated Seeds as potential emerging topics, (5) sub-component breakdown enabling causal interpretation of why an article scores high/low.
